newsitem.title: USA: BLIMPIE sees record sales, earnings in 97.
newsitem.headline: BLIMPIE sees record sales, earnings in 97.

text.p: BLIMPIE International Inc said on Tuesday it expected fiscal 1997 to be its ninth consecutive year of record sales and earnings, and that its international development would start to benefit earnings.

While Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President Anthony Conza declined to comment on specific earnings or sales projections for the year, he said the company's international growth strategy was starting to help its results.
The company is a franchisor of sandwich outlets.
